newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - May 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - May 26.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Abu Dhabi sets up a 500-million-dirham leasing company.
- Direct foreign investments in Tunisia exceed $500 million a year.
- Iranian president confirms his support to newly- elected Khatami.
- A Saudi court gives the opportunity for settlement in the case of two British nurses accused of killing their Australian colleague.
- Saudi Arabia to join World Trade Organisation next year, a Saudi official says.
